decisions.statement: A passage names the book of scripture the passage is in.
A passage's verses are a file beside the passage's page.
A passage catalogued before its verses arrive has no file yet.
A passage names a rendering only where the record the passage came from names a rendering.
A passage sits in the folder named for the book of scripture the passage is in.
A passage opening its name with a chapter number is slugged for its page type first.
A passage takes its unit from its kind rather than stating a unit of its own.
The collection a passage is part of is no page.

definition: one chapter of scripture Alan reads
